title: Normalized field-action topos datum
statement:
Let $k$ be a field with specified separable closure $k^s/k$ [def-pd-separable-closure], $s=\operatorname{Spec}k$, $\bar s=\operatorname{Spec}k^s$, and $G=\operatorname{Aut}_k(k^s)$ with its Krull topology. Use compatible universes [def-weil-size-convention], the small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], its qcqs subsite [def-weil-pbc-proetale-qcqs-subsite], and the small profinite parameter site $(B,J_B)$, its underlying-parameter equivalence, internal $\underline G$-actions and trivial coefficients [def-sfb-profinite-action-base-coefficients]. The free profinite $G$-spaces are $G\times P$ with left translation [def-sfb-profinite-action-parameters], and $T[P]=\varprojlim_i\coprod_{P_i}T$ denotes the actual profinite test functor [lem-weil-pbc-profinite-test-object-functor].

Define a normalized field-action topos datum to consist of an equivalence $E:\operatorname{Sh}(s_{\mathrm{proet}})\simeq\operatorname{Cond}^{\underline G}$, a geometric action-site restriction datum, and a fully faithful free-subsite functor into $s_{qcqs,\mathrm{proet}}$ dense for the induced topology. Include a field-site equivalence identifying each free object with $G\times P$, under which a labeled arrow $(f,b)$ is $(g,t)\mapsto(gb(t),f(t))$, with unique continuous coordinates. Include geometric test identifications with $\bar s[P]$, natural in $P$, and requiring the label $\sigma$ to act by the actual $\operatorname{Spec}(\sigma)$ and leave the profinite coordinate fixed. Include natural section identifications $(EF)(P)\cong F(\bar s[P])$ carrying $(f,b)$ to $b$ acting on $f^*$, and a covering criterion: a finite labeled family covers exactly when its parameter maps jointly surject.

Include the point inverse image and direct image with their specified adjunction and arithmetic evaluation $p_{s*}F(P)=F(s[P])$ [sk-def-sfb-pullback-from-point]. Include the trivial-action inverse image, its right adjoint of invariant sections, the isomorphism $p_{s*}\cong E\,\Gamma_G$, the inclusion of invariants as its adjunction counit, and the natural underlying-sheaf identification for trivial action, with trivial local action. The inclusion is injective and its image is precisely the sections fixed after every profinite base change. Include the actual cover $\bar s[P]\to s[P]$, preserving the profinite coordinate, and require the right-adjoint comparison followed by inclusion to be restriction along this cover. Its equalizer is the universal fixed-section subobject; include its kernel-pair description with coordinates $(g,h,p)$ and projections $(g,p),(gh,p)$. Include a left-adjoint comparison $Ep_s^{-1}\cong p_G^{-1}$ which is the mate of this exact right-adjoint comparison, finite-limit preservation of both inverse images, and compatibility of the same comparison with every finite-arity operation and every morphism. For every commutative condensed ring [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring], include the coefficient identification with its trivial action, with underlying map equal to this left-adjoint comparison, compatible with the ring operations and natural in every ring morphism. This defines the type of the datum, and makes no choice of an inhabitant.
